official.description: Fudan University's notice for the 2026 Chinese Government Scholarship (Chinese University Program) sets out a CSC Type B award for international students: a tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation or an accommodation subsidy, comprehensive medical insurance, and a monthly living stipend of 3000 RMB for master's students and 3500 RMB for doctoral students, applied for through both Campus China and Fudan's own application system.

official.english_requirement: The scholarship notice itself publishes no language score. applicant_utility.summary: This is the CSC Type B (Chinese University Program) route at Fudan: you file once with Campus China under Agency No. 10246 and once with Fudan, and the money reaches you as a monthly stipend rather than a lump sum. The published figures are 3,000 RMB a month for master's students and 3,500 RMB a month for doctoral students, alongside a tuition waiver, campus accommodation or a subsidy, and comprehensive medical insurance. Because Type B caps you at a single university in the CSC system, a careless entry there can cost you the entire award, so treat the CSC submission and Fudan's 'Chinese Government Scholarship' option as two halves of one application. The round for the 2026 intake closed on 10 December 2025, so the practical task now is to be ready when the next call appears on the ISO Notices column.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-Chinese master's and doctoral applicants under 35 and 40 respectively who want a Fudan degree with tuition, accommodation and a stipend covered, and who can commit to Fudan as their only Type B university.
application_readiness_checklist: Settle before the window opens that Fudan is your single Type B choice, because the CSC system will not let you apply to a second university in this category

Book the Foreigner Physical Examination Form early: it must be completed by a hospital in Chinese or English and stays valid for only six months, so a form finished in June expires before a late-year round
Line up two referees who are professors or associate professors and can return handwritten, signed letters in Chinese or English within the window
Arrange notarised Chinese or English translations for every diploma and transcript not already in one of those two languages
Check that your passport expires after 1 March of the year following intake and renew it before applying, because passport information cannot be changed after admission
Have the 800 RMB application fee ready for online payment, since Fudan treats an unpaid application as invalid
common_rejection_risks: Applying to more than one university in the CSC system for Type B, which rules out the whole submission

Selecting a fund source other than 'Self-support' in Fudan's own system, or skipping the 'Chinese Government Scholarship' option in the Scholarship section, so the CSC form never reaches the assessors
A physical examination form that is out of date, unsigned, unsealed or missing the photograph
Holding, or failing to disclose, another Chinese government scholarship, which triggers cancellation, repayment and a three-year bar on further CSC applications
Arriving after the registration date on the admission notice without prior approval, which cancels the scholarship automatically
Language test scores issued more than two years before the examination date
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: International airfare, visa and residence-permit costs, the 800 RMB application fee, personal spending beyond the monthly stipend, and any English-taught programme costs beyond the waiver are on the applicant; Fudan publishes no travel allowance for this award.
document_audit: The Foreigner Physical Examination Form must be issued by a hospital, completed in Chinese or English, carry a photograph with the cross-page seal, and show the doctor's signature and hospital stamp; a form missing any of these is treated as invalid
Recommendation letters need the referee's handwritten signature, so allow for courier or wet-ink time rather than a last-minute email
Applicants who once held a PRC Travel Document or Exit and Entry Permit need a Certificate of Renunciation of Chinese Nationality, which takes weeks to obtain
Every document that is not in Chinese or English needs a notarised translation submitted alongside the original
If you are already living in China, decide early between the physical examination route and the alternative Residence Permit or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card route
alerts: The window closes in early December and no next-cycle date is published yet, so monitor the ISO Notices column instead of relying on a fixed calendar date
New scholarship students must pass an annual evaluation, and neither the major nor the study period may be changed after admission
Enrolment falls in late August or early September, so visa appointments have to be booked well ahead of the registration date printed on the admission notice
Fudan's postgraduate guides publish different Phase One windows (10 and 12 December) for this spring of applications, so submit against the earlier date rather than the later one
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: File the CSC application on Campus China first, print and sign it, then submit the Fudan application, choose 'Self-support' plus the 'Chinese Government Scholarship' option, upload the signed form and health examination report, pay the fee, and read the result in the ISO Notices column.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a school-level award funded by Zhejiang University's International School of Medicine in Yiwu, not a government scholarship, and it is open only to doctoral candidates in that school's medical programmes. Two tiers exist: tier A pays 7,000 RMB a month and tier B pays 3,500 RMB a month, and both waive tuition, give free on-campus accommodation and comprehensive medical insurance, so the money question is really about which tier you land in. Application runs on two tracks at once: the school's own scholarship form emailed to ismgraduate@zju.edu.cn with a prescribed subject line, and the same form uploaded inside the ZJU international student application system, with both completed before the deadline. The annual cycle closes on 28 February and the tier outcome follows the school's video interview.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Doctoral applicants in medicine and the health sciences who are set on the International School of Medicine in Yiwu and can carry a video interview plus the physical examination and police clearance paperwork.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm early that your intended programme in the ZJU system carries the 'International School of Medicine' suffix and that your preferred college is set to 医学院, since the award is only visible to that combination
Identify a ZJU supervisor and secure the Form for Provisional Acceptance where the programme requires it, because it shapes the video interview
Download the school's scholarship application form from the scholarship page and complete it in Chinese or English
Time the Foreigner Physical Examination Record so it stays inside its six-month validity, and verify the photograph, cross-page seal, doctor's signature and hospital seal before uploading
Obtain a police clearance certificate from your local public security authority, which also expires after six months
Pay the 800 RMB application fee inside the ZJU system before the deadline, since applications without it are treated as invalid
common_rejection_risks: Emailing the scholarship form without the prescribed subject line of application number + passport name + programme name
Sending other documents by post or email; the school states that only the scholarship application form is accepted by email and that paper submissions are not reviewed
Leaving the preferred college or programme set to anything other than the International School of Medicine, which moves the application out of this scholarship's pool
Holding another scholarship at the same time, which the rules exclude outright
An incomplete physical examination record, where a missing item, photograph, cross-page seal, signature or hospital seal renders it invalid
Documents lapsing between submission and registration, since both the health record and the police clearance are valid for only six months
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Return and onward airfare (the rules make a holder who suspends for serious illness pay their own way home), visa costs, the 800 RMB application fee, personal spending beyond the monthly allowance, and any English-instruction surcharge: the university's fees page lists 8,000 RMB per academic year for programmes whose language of instruction is English, so confirm with the school whether that charge applies on top of the tuition waiver.
document_audit: Both the Foreigner Physical Examination Record and the police clearance certificate carry a six-month validity, so schedule them against the February deadline rather than completing them too early
The health record is submitted as a photocopy with the original kept by the applicant, and must be completed in Chinese or English against the required examination items
The school's scholarship application form is the only document accepted by email; everything else goes through the ZJU international student application system
Admission requires a personal statement of at least 1,500 words in Chinese or English, covering academic background, work experience, reasons for application and study proposal
Two recommendation letters should come from full or associate professors, with signature, contact phone number and email address on the letter
alerts: The 28 February date is a standing annual deadline and the page still carries the 2025 edition, so confirm the current year's call on the International College notice board before relying on it
The video interview is a formal part of selection alongside research ability, academic performance and language level, so prepare for it as a real assessment rather than a formality
Recipients may not change institution, programme or study length after arriving in China, and suspension for reasons other than approved illness forfeits the entitlement
The living allowance starts on enrolment: a full month if you register by the 15th, half a month after that, and it stops for unexplained absence or leaving campus without approval
Scholarship status is reviewed annually and can be suspended or cancelled if the review is failed, so keep academic performance steady after admission
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the ZJU online application and pay the fee, email the school's scholarship form to ismgraduate@zju.edu.cn with the prescribed subject line, upload the same form and the full admission dossier to the ZJU system before the deadline, then read the result in the system at the end of July or the beginning of August.
